question: Using Figure 6B-1 and Section 6B.06, list the main TTC-zone areas in travel order and identify the three components of the activity area.
model_answer: Direct Answer: In the direction of travel, a TTC zone is typically divided into four areas: the advance warning area (tells traffic what to expect ahead), the transition area (moves traffic out of its normal path), the activity area (where the work takes place), and the termination area (lets traffic resume normal operations). The activity area itself is comprised of three components: the work space, the traffic space, and the buffer space. These divisions are descriptive (Support), not mandatory requirements. Standards (mandatory): - No Standard provision governs the naming or ordering of these areas; the division into four areas is explanatory (Support) and is applied "as needed, based on engineering judgment." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 6B-1 depicts the four areas in travel order—advance warning area, transition area, activity area (containing the hatched work space, the traffic space allowing traffic to pass through, and lateral/longitudinal buffer spaces), and termination area with a downstream taper. [Image 2] shows the Section 6B.06 text stating the activity area "is comprised of the work space, the traffic space, and the buffer space." [Image 3] shows Section 6B.03, which lists the four areas and refers to Figure 6B-1. Support (explanatory): - "A TTC zone is often divided into four areas as needed, based on engineering judgment: the advance warning area, the transition area, the activity area, and the termination area. Figure 6B-1 illustrates the four areas typically included in a TTC zone." - "The activity area is the section of the highway where the work activity takes place. It is comprised of the work space, the traffic space, and the buffer space." - "The traffic space is the portion of the highway in which road users are routed through the activity area." Citations: - Section 6B.03 Support §1 (p.771) - Section 6B.06 Support §1 (p.773) - Section 6B.06 Support §5 (p.773) - Figure 6B-1 (p.772) - Page 812 - Page 814
gold_answer: Advance warning, transition, activity, and termination. The activity area consists of the work space, traffic space, and buffer space.
